channel.title: US Top News and Analysis
channel.description: CNBC is the world leader in business news and real-time financial market coverage. Find fast, actionable information.

item.title: The world appears to be entering a higher-rate era. Here’s who will pay the price
item.description: The bond sell-off is owed to a mix of high government debt issuance, an oil-price shock that has reignited inflation concerns, and expectations of higher rates.

item.title: Iran strikes Kuwait as Trump says renewed Mideast hostilities will not last 'too long'
item.description: On Thursday, Kuwait's army said it was confronting hostile missile and drone attacks from Iran.

item.title: 'No steering wheel, no pedals.' Tesla teases fans ahead of long-awaited Cybercab update
item.description: Tesla first unveiled the Cybercab almost two years ago, and fans of the company have been waiting to hear more.

item.title: Putin floats 'chance' at peace with Ukraine as NATO chief warns Russia is becoming 'increasingly reckless'
item.description: Putin said peace with Ukraine remains possible while calling Kyiv’s warning on Russian airspace “state terrorism,” as NATO flags fresh risks.

item.title: Moderna is now overvalued after cancer vaccine-led stock surge, Rothschild & Co. says
item.description: The research firm downgraded the biotechnology stock to sell from neutral.

item.title: NBA suspends Clippers owner Ballmer for one year in Kawhi Leonard salary cap probe
item.description: The NBA also fined the Los Angeles Clippers $30 million and said the team will forfeit five first-round picks, one in each year in drafts starting in 2029.

item.title: China hits back at G20 statement on its reliance on exports, accusing them of 'promoting protectionism'
item.description: China rejected G20 pressure over export-driven growth while also challenging U.S. Iran sanctions and European trade measures.

item.title: Broadcom delivers strong earnings view as CEO touts growth with AI labs
item.description: Broadcom gave a disappointing revenue forecast for the current quarter but provided robust earnings guidance for fiscal 2028.

item.title: Trump and Xi are set to meet in DC. Why some China watchers have low expectations
item.description: Trump's summit with Xi is expected to take place less than six weeks before the U.S. election, with polls showing Democrats favored to make gains in Congress.

item.title: Gloria Steinem, a potent voice of U.S. feminism and co-founder of Ms. Magazine, has died
item.description: Gloria Steinem, the co-founder of Ms. Magazine and a fierce advocate for feminist causes throughout her life, has died. She was 92.

item.title: Dutch central bank moves gold bars out of U.S. and Canada, citing ‘crisis preparedness’
item.description: DNB said gold stored with the Bank of England is more readily tradable, allowing it to be deployed more quickly in a severe crisis.

item.title: Hidden China risks are emerging in America’s multibillion-dollar AI data center boom
item.description: U.S. AI data centers rely on China-linked supplies of transformers, batteries and optical gear as Washington moves to tighten restrictions on foreign equipment.

item.title: Ford's production of highly profitable Super Duty trucks hits 20-year high as it recovers from supplier fires
item.description: Ford reported its eighth consecutive month of year-over-year U.S. new vehicle sales declines in August.

item.title: Google starts September with AI momentum after longest monthly losing streak in over a decade
item.description: After a slow but extended selloff on Wall Steet, Google began September with renewed momentum, helped by new AI models.

item.title: PG&E CEO calls on California to pass wildfire reform after the shelved effort crushed the stock
item.description: PG&E CEO Patti Poppe said she's hopeful California lawmakers can revive wildfire liability reform after a failed proposal sent the utility’s shares tumbling.

item.title: Snowflake spikes 22% on healthy results and AI coding momentum
item.description: Snowflake business is growing quickly, in part thanks to adoption of an artificial intelligence agent for writing code.

item.title: EnQuest is interested in buying BP’s North Sea assets, CEO tells CNBC
item.description: EnQuest CEO Amjad Bseisu told CNBC the company is interested in BP’s U.K. North Sea assets as the oil major explores a sale of the business.

item.title: Why Hilton calls this Asian country the fastest-growing tourism market
item.description: Hilton says one Asian country is the most exciting global tourism market as regional travel surges.

item.title: States now must report undocumented immigrants to DHS or risk federal funding, DOJ says
item.description: The new DOJ opinion relates to funding states get for Temporary Assistance for Needy Families and the Supplemental Security Income programs.

item.title: Broadcom guides to big numbers but investors wanted more. Why we're OK to hold for now
item.description: We recently reduced our position size, which allows us to be more patient with this one.

item.title: New Jersey asks the Supreme Court to take on prediction markets
item.description: The petition comes after a key ruling from the 9th U.S. Circuit Court of Appeals on sports-event contracts.

item.title: How to save on Thanksgiving travel with your credit card
item.description: Holiday travel is more expensive this year, but with the right card (and smart planning), you can keep costs down.

item.title: How Equinix has found a niche in the multitrillion-dollar AI data center boom
item.description: Nvidia announced a new data center deal with Equinix and Together AI on Wednesday to help enterprise customers with open-model inference.

item.title: Microsoft to start disclosing Azure quarterly revenue as company consolidates business units
item.description: Microsoft will begin reporting quarterly Azure revenue in dollars for the first time, providing more clarity about its business that competes with AWS.

item.title: Yen jumps to one-month high as traders weigh chance of further intervention
item.description: U.S. Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent told CNBC on Monday he believed Japanese authorities would take action to lead to a stronger yen.

item.title: Southwest to debut airport lounges in four cities, with more to come
item.description: The airline is partnering with Chase on the effort, saying it wants to build on that company's Sapphire Reserve Lounge Network.

item.title: G20 tech takeaways: Lutnick pitches adoption of U.S. AI, pushes data center buildout
item.description: Follow Day 2 of the G20 Innovation Ministerial in Chapel Hill, North Carolina, with Jensen Huang, Sam Altman, and ministers discussing AI, policy and trade.

item.title: Shipping stocks at a crossroads amid their best rally in decades
item.description: A months-long crisis in the Strait of Hormuz has turned an overlooked corner of the market into one of 2026's hottest trades.

item.title: South Korea's semiconductor exports just tripled year-over-year. Is it too much of a good thing?
item.description: If growth were to slow in the semiconductor sector, would the slowdown take the Korean economy with it?

item.title: China's slowdown pushes New Zealand exporters to diversify away from their top buyer, RBNZ official tells CNBC
item.description: New Zealand exporters are diverting shipments bound for China to new markets, as demand from the country's top buyer cools, a central bank official tells CNBC.
